camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries WebSocket network traffic data for accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData查询域名的WebSocket网络流量监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-websocket-traffic-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainWebsocketTrafficData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

To query data for multiple domain names, separate them with commas (,). By default, this operation queries data for all accelerated domain names
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for the query, in seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported time granularity varies based on the maximum time range per query. For more information, see the Supported time granularities section in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The name of the carrier in English.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to obtain the name. By default, data for all carriers is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region in English.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to obtain the name. By default, data for all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data records, in seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The start of the time range
